name: Ops - WF74 Scoreboard Rollup Gate
owner_workflow: WF74 recursive self-improvement loop / PM rollup
contract_reason: The WF74 scoreboards regenerate once nightly at 21:40 but nothing rolls actionable high-priority items up to Main for disposition or into the PM queue. On 2026-09-16 the same stale-source lag produced three false top-priority items in one day, and completed work stayed open because nothing closed it with proof. This gate reads the post-digest scoreboards read-only, wakes Main only when the actionable set changes or the scoreboards are stale/unreadable (watchdog on the 21:40 regen), and requires the woken turn to disposition each item and confirm PM state.
description: Nightly post-digest WF74 scoreboard rollup gate. Read-only trigger inspects the improvement-opportunity queue and decision docket; wakes Main only when the actionable high-priority set changes, or the scoreboard is stale/unreadable (watchdog on the 21:40 Ops - OTEL Local Digest regen). Review-only routing; no auto-apply, no schedule/config/canon mutation, no authority expansion.

payload.message: WF74 scoreboard rollup gate. The nightly post-digest gate detected actionable high-priority WF74 items requiring Main disposition and PM routing. The trigger message lists the current items; if it is absent, read tmp/wf74-decision-docket.json and tmp/wf74-improvement-opportunity-queue.json directly (both freshly regenerated by the 21:40 Ops - OTEL Local Digest; do not re-run it). For each item: verify already-completed items with proof before claiming done; route PM-lane items into the PM implementation queue per docket gates; skill items are Skill Workshop proposal-only; cron items stay plan-only pending owner approval; defer known post-G8 backlog with reason. Then confirm PM control packet state. Boundaries: review and routing only - no auto-apply, no canon/finance/config/schedule/runtime mutation, no capital/execution/account action, no authority expansion. The G8 observation window is active: alerts-OS chain files are frozen. Reply NO_REPLY only when nothing needs action.

contract_update_reason: 2026-09-25 (Randall 11:41 MST approved gate fix): trigger read exec output from r.stdout/output/text (absent; documented field is r.aggregated) so every run parsed the wrapper object and fired a false unreadable; previous state read from state instead of trigger.state so dedupe never worked. Fixed both; harness tmp/wf74-gate-fix-20260925/test_trigger.mjs 8/8. Trigger scripts are not in compare_fields (validator blind spot).
